result.citation: Cal. Gov. Code § 66300.6(b)(4)(A) (Housing Crisis Act of 2019; added by Stats. 2023, ch. 754, AB 1218; amended by Stats. 2025, ch. 511, SB 21)
result.citation_basis: § 66300.6(b)(4)(A) and Stats. 2025, ch. 511, SB 21: O001; Housing Crisis Act of 2019: O001 and D043; Stats. 2023, ch. 754, AB 1218: O001 (Article 2 added by Stats. 2023, Ch. 754) and O003 (Stats. 2023, Ch. 754 (AB 1218))
result.official_quote: (4) The developer agrees to provide both of the following to the existing occupants of any protected units that are lower income households: (A) Relocation benefits that are equivalent to the relocation benefits required to be paid by public entities pursuant to Chapter 16 (commencing with Section 7260) of Division 7 of Title 1 and any implementing regulations.
result.note: The section and subsection are unchanged, but the history now follows the official code page: AB 1218 (Stats. 2023, ch. 754) added the article and SB 21 (Stats. 2025, ch. 511) made the latest amendment, replacing the agency bulletin's 'SB 330, as amended by SB 8 and AB 1218' wording, which leaves out SB 21.
